page.layout: One printed page, the left one of the opening, with running text in one column on the right and marginal notes in the left margin. The page number and running head are at the top. The catchword is at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: fortuna: de rebus bene praeclareq; gestis: de honore & dignitate, de affinitate, hisq; similibus aliis gratulamur: & eidem, aut usum illorum diuturnum, aut similem in caeteris quoque successum precamur. Id quod veri est amici officium: saepe etiam necessarium, propter homines auctoritate & potentia magna praeditos: quibus de aucta dignitate: nominis amplificata gloria: rebus laudabiliter fortiterque administratis, gratulari nos oportet. Est autem diligens in his & accurata primo, cum rerum, tum personarum ratio habenda vi-dendumque sintne ea, propter quae gratulatio instituenda, magna, & apud viros usurpanda magnos, ideoque amplam, or-natam, splendidam tractationem requirant: an vero exigua ac minutula, ut qui splendore in iis, aut ornatu magno uta-tur, in lente, quod aiunt, unguentum adhibere videatur. Deinde de argumentis est cogitandum, eademque eo dirigenda: ut laetitiae nos & gratulationis causas habere iustas appareat. Sumuntur autem illa ex causis, effectis, adiunctis, comparatis: & ostenditur esse ea, quorum gratia amico gratulamur, virtute, consilio, laboribus, meritis praeclaris: non casu, gratia, pren-In gratula-toriis Epistolis quae con-fideranda[?].

page.notes: The left margin holds two notes: "In gratulatoriis Epistolis quae confideranda" beside the lines "niftratis" to "rum", where the word "confideranda" is only partly legible, and "Argumenta gratulationum." beside the lines "bere iuftas" to "la ex causis". The second note is not included in the main text above; the transcription keeps only the first note at its place. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, following the rules, so "est", "esse", "necessarium" and similar forms read this way. A stray "/" mark appears at the lower right of the text area; it is not printed text and is left out. The catchword "latio-" is a catchword at the right below the last line.
